structuredContent.body:
Compressor now offers a provider-owned Peak/RMS detector selector. Peak remains the default with unchanged PCM; RMS uses independent 10ms exponential channel mean-square histories, then sqrt of the larger averaged energy. A finite 5ms detector-input transition preserves warm history during mode changes, dry output and bypass. The existing 326px panel retains all controls and adds the shared selector with a truthful static detector-level caption.

Explicit dependency: PR453 frozen `1ce92988bcef49f606ab8e54f47772733bd7a6b0` supplies Dry/Wet ID7. This PR adds Choice ID8 and codec3/32bytes, preserving that work. Dependency merge `2734f489ce5fe1d31ae5aaf621ee5e0a360f2b86` contains intake main47315049 plus453; only the final commit is this issue's own delta (six files, 774 insertions/16 deletions). Unsupported alpha1/2 formats are refused; no migration or user-file conversion.

Validation: 24 provider tests (original Peak/DryWet goldens plus independent analytic energy, PCM, stereo, transition and lifecycle cases), five rendered Track/Return UI tests, two Engine cases, storage and registry conformance passed. A calibrated allocation probe passed 36 rate/mode/mix cases. Strict all-target Clippy for affected devices/UI/Storage and architecture/GPUI/style/layout/fmt/diff checks passed. Raw red tests and the corrected test-only mutability diagnostic are preserved.

Frozen source `b8f3b4cd00bdf6c48b790af97161749a19f90d28`, tree `0144e9edefac75bbf4ff1f6ece73a554cc0fb8d7`. [Immutable evidence manifest](https://github.com/PORTALSURFER/hex/blob/2689ec6b9e400fd04e30922027bfbe35b60e0df7/artifacts/compressor-rms/b8f3b4cd00bdf6c48b790af97161749a19f90d28/manifest.json), SHA256 `6c01ced6910334665b11c656a5c86b0119c227217c02caca451aa15aa7babf96`. Evidence branch is orphan/NEVER MERGE.

This implements the original Hex law accepted in Pulse2683 note26410, not measured Live numeric parity or full Compressor/W12 completion. Sole merger owns prospective full required local CI/review/merge. Actual combined447 A/B and native appearance/listening acceptance remain open. Pulse2853 stays In Progress until authenticated merge.
